verdict.rationale: x402 documents a batch-settlement scheme in which many per-request payment vouchers are verified offchain and claimed together. One onchain transaction can process thousands of payments, which is a real bulk operation over many payments. However, it covers only settlement aggregation, not a general way for a user or agent to act on many items at once. Missing for 10: a documented bulk API for paying or acting on multiple resources in one request, bulk operations beyond settlement (e.g., bulk refunds or bulk management), and hands-on or independent corroboration of batch settlement working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: vouchers are verified offchain for free and claimed together, so one onchain transaction can process thousands of payments
Batch settlement lets agents perform thousands of granular interactions while maintaining the economic efficiency of a single transaction.
defer settlement for a batch of payments
